+"""Url interpolation: ${NAME} references with extra checks."""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+from lamina.errors import InterpolationError
+
+
+def _valid(value: str) -> bool:
+    return value.strip() == value
+
+
+def interpolate_url(value: str, env: Mapping[str, str], *, line: int = 0, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    """Expand ${NAME} references in value using env (url rules)."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(value)
+    out_parts: list[str] = []
+    i = 0
+    while True:
+        start = value.find("${", i)
+        if start < 0:
+            out_parts.append(value[i:])
+            return "".join(out_parts)
+        end = value.find("}", start)
+        if end < 0:
+            raise InterpolationError("unterminated reference", line, start + 1)
+        out_parts.append(value[i:start])
+        name = value[start + 2:end]
+        if name not in env:
+            raise InterpolationError(f"undefined variable {name}", line, start + 1)
+        resolved = env[name]
+        if not _valid(resolved):
+            raise InterpolationError(f"invalid value {resolved!r} for {name}", line, start + 1)
+        out_parts.append(resolved)
+        i = end + 1

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.errors import InterpolationError
+from lamina.interpolate.url import interpolate_url
+
+
+def test_url_expands():
+    assert interpolate_url("a-${X}", {"X": "1"}) == "a-1"
+
+
+def test_url_undefined():
+    with pytest.raises(InterpolationError):
+        interpolate_url("${NOPE}", {})
+
+
+def test_url_plain_text():
+    assert interpolate_url("plain", {}) == "plain"
